title: IrisProjectSchema
description: Local-first Studio Project manifest for iris-sync, providing InterSystems Studio (.PRJ / %Studio.Project) parity for tracked file sets and deployment packaging

$schema.description: URI or URL referencing this JSON schema definition

version.description: Schema version of the project manifest

description.description: Human-readable description of this project manifest and its purpose

serverProject.description: Corresponding InterSystems IRIS server project document name (e.g. 'BillingService.PRJ')

targetNamespace.description: Target IRIS database namespace for project synchronization and deployment

exportFormat.description: Format for project promotion packages (XML, UDL, or Global Output Format)

items.description: Ordered collection of workspace-relative file paths tracked by this project manifest

dependencies.description: List of prerequisite projects that must be deployed or compiled prior to this project
